views.note: Students browse week notes, labs, and capstone pages rendered from the MDX content collection.

views.label: Build and deploy path

views.label: Bilingual content path
views.note: Root Korean and en locale share the Starlight sidebar with dynamic phase expansion.

cards.title: Course
items: Cheju Halla University AI department 4th-year course: agentic workflows and harness engineering, 16 weeks across 5 phases
16 week notes (week-01 to week-16), 12 labs, and capstone pages in src/content/docs/
Phase topics run HOTL governance, MCP architecture, Ralph loops, multi-agent SDLC, and open-weight MLOps with vLLM

cards.title: Stack
items: Astro 6 with Starlight 0.38 integration, MDX content, sharp image processing (package.json)
Bilingual locales: root label Korean and en English with custom ThemeSelect and LanguageSelect components
Build-time active phase computed in astro.config.mjs from SEMESTER_START 2026-03-03 to auto-expand the current phase sidebar

cards.title: Deploy
items: Static build to dist/ via make build, preview via make preview (Makefile)
GitHub Actions deploy.yml pushes to GitHub Pages with CNAME for ai-systems-2026.halla.ai
Edit links point to github.com/halla-ai/ai-systems-2026 with lastUpdated enabled
